name: repair-d82-graph-root-order-artifact
mutation_description: Two parentless receipts: the inference root (smaller receipt_id, epoch_seq 1) carries a standing_condition_trigger root, forbidden for an inference; the observation root (larger receipt_id, epoch_seq 0) lacks its descriptor. Artifact order reports root-forbidden; epoch_seq order would report root-missing. The observation's nonce is salted until the ids order that way.
